name: Maycrackmon: Vicious Mode
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may trash 1 card in your hand. If you trash a purple card, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon. If you trash a yellow card, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn.
source_effect: [On Deletion] When this Digimon had 2 or more colurs, gain 2 memory.
